name: Ricochet imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, holding a bouncy round glowing ember like a ball, knees bent like a pitcher, gleeful

poses.stand: hovering on spread bat wings, bouncing the round glowing ember from hand to hand
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers, bouncing the round ember off its knee and catching it

attack.action: winds up like a pitcher and throws the round ember forward and down to the right so it will bounce

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
